verdicts.missing: The specification gives record numbers and status codes but leaves open whether the response lists every failed record and explains the specific cause for each.

verdicts.quote: Reject existing or in-batch email collisions case-insensitively with 409 and the offending record number.

verdicts.missing: The token identifies who may import. The specification does not define a separate permission for creating one user or its relationship to import permission.

Handle UTF-8 BOM, LF and CRLF, optional final newline, quoted commas, escaped quotes and quoted newlines.

Import completion is synchronous and needs no job or cache.
verdicts.missing: Accepted uploads finish within the HTTP request. The specification provides no background processing or completion notice for a large file.

verdicts.quote: Editing, deleting, account sign-in and durable storage are outside CSV creation.
verdicts.missing: Sign-in is explicitly outside scope. The specification does not say whether an imported user has an activation status or a password at creation.
The request bounds retention and rules out later retrieval of the original upload. The specification leaves open where the bytes are held during the request.

verdicts.quote: Reject existing or in-batch email collisions case-insensitively with 409 and the offending record number.
verdicts.missing: An existing email cannot be overwritten by import. The specification describes a read-only baseline and gives no manual single-user creation behavior to preserve.
